name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Arnold Pipeline
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Description

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. What are you trying to do that you can't do today?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible — include API design, configuration keys, CLI flags, or behavioral changes you envision.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered and why they fall short.

## Impact

Who benefits from this feature? Does it affect the CLI, programmatic API, configuration, execution providers, or the library system?

## Additional Context

Any other context, links to related issues, or examples from other tools that implement something similar.
